name: wonderland-startup
source:
Set Buffer 10
Amos Lock
Close Editor
Timer=7
Print Timer

encoding.notes: Literal original token offsets 04fe, 24e0, 171a, 12ce, ffa2 and 0476; decimal integer token 003e, explicit physical line lengths and terminators. No production encoder or name table.

evidence.notes: Source-derived expectations, not AMOS execution captures. Buffer request is preserved as compile metadata; AMOS heap capacity is not enforced. Host lock/editor effects use the explicit adapter contract. VBL increment and wrap are checked separately with injected clocks.
